headword: {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}

definitions.gloss: negotiations conducted in advance of a formal meeting, contract, or decision, with the aim of aligning positions before the main discussion takes place
definitions.explanation: Talks held before a formal event — a signing, public meeting, vote, or international summit — to iron out differences, confirm shared expectations, and prevent surprises. {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう} is closely related to {根回|ねまわ}し (behind-the-scenes groundwork) but is more explicitly bilateral and typically more visible: both sides acknowledge that talks are taking place, even if the contents are not made public. Common in business deals, union–management relations, and diplomacy.

examples.japanese: {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Prior negotiations are under way between the two countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Before signing the contract, we need to hold prior negotiations with the other company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地道|じみち}→地道：15599_jimichi⟧な{事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧だ。
examples.english: The summit succeeded precisely because there had been patient prior negotiations at the working level.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧ (in advance, prior) + ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧ (negotiation). A written, formal-sounding word common in business, labor, and political contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct prior negotiations
- {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to advance prior negotiations
- {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまる→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧: prior negotiations come together / are settled
- {事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}する→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧: prior negotiations run into difficulty
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事前交渉|じぜんこうしょう}: working-level prior negotiations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧: behind-the-scenes groundwork — more informal and one-sided; often done by one party quietly building support before a meeting or decision.
- {予備交渉|よびこうしょう}: preliminary negotiations — a close synonym, used especially in diplomatic contexts for formal "pre-talks."
- {下交渉|したこうしょう}: preliminary / preparatory negotiation — emphasizes that the main negotiations are still to come.
- ⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧: a meeting to coordinate plans — much less formal and broader in scope; not necessarily about reconciling positions.

REGISTER:
Formal and written. Appears in business reports, union documents, and news coverage of political and diplomatic affairs. In casual conversation, people usually say ⟦{前|まえ}もって→前もって：03765_maemotte⟧{話|はなし}し{合|あ}う (to talk things over beforehand) or ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧ (to consult in advance).

USAGE:
- Business: vendor–client contract talks, mergers and acquisitions, joint-venture discussions
- Labor relations: union–management talks before a formal bargaining session
- Politics and diplomacy: summit meetings, treaty signings, ceasefire talks
